decisions.reason: Turnaround management software is close to the core offer, has had its own page in both years, and costs little to maintain, so the option stays open while its value keeps showing.
Visibility rose from a mention to a dedicated page, which signals rising commitment, and the low marginal cost of a software module justifies keeping it as uncertainty resolves.
Billing software was promoted to its own page in 2024, which points to positive early results, and it supports the integrated, data-driven direction at modest holding cost.
Equipment monitoring builds on the installed base and expanding service business, and its upgrade to a dedicated page indicates the firm is investing further rather than abandoning it.
